name: zgeometry_weiler_merge_contours
description: zGeometry_Weiler::MergeContours validates crossing records, rewires contour segment links for crossing cases, and ensures merged contour outputs exist.
known_limits: Binary Ninja has documented HLIL limitations where first-field contour-link updates render as bare stores. Assembly is the accepted behavior evidence.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x467710 validates the ValidateXings precheck, crossing-count loop, xingType dispatch, case-1 link rewrites for xingType 4, EnsureContourOutput calls for segment4 and segment6, and success return.

The native clip leaf smoke verifies xingType 4 case-1 merge link rewrites, contour output allocation count, output first-segment pointers, output contour types, and segment contour-output back pointers.
